claims.title: P1 coefficient-one receiver fusion on a qualified noncompact domain

quoted_fields.interface: One globally proper quadratic receiver Vhat supports E[T+Jnc(T)+Vhat(XT)]<=Vhat(x) on the union of high,both-low,mixed-sign large-residual,and retuned fixed-H,L positive-unpaired/small-cold regimes. Repeated switching stops at the first episode endpoint outside that union,not necessarily its first physical exit.
quoted_fields.failure: Rmix requires A,D>=3 and |r_i|>=max(anchor_i+2,R_i);there all signs,minority scales and anchor ratios are allowed. The total fusion domain is noncompact,not all states. Missing angular/activation regions and full recurrence remain open. Service receiver W is not automatically fused:its leading U/W ratios differ144-fold on the stated rays.
